about: The secreta of the formulary “Dedication of Saint Michael the Archangel” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We offer You sacrifices of praise, O Lord, humbly praying You to accept them graciously and to grant that they may be helpful for our salvation through the intercession of the Angels who intercede for us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
